671056.author: Chase Davis
671056.title: Ivan Herrera keeps raking in win over Rockies
671056.desc: Ivan Herrera went 3-for-5 in win over the Rockies with a double, two runs scored, two RBI, and one strikeout.
671056.impact: After Sunday's win over Colorado, Herrera is batting .251 with 16 home runs, 64 RBI, 89 runs scored, eight stolen bases, a .336 wOBA and a .291 BABIP across 143 games. He's got six multi-hit performances in his last seven games, piling up 13 hits, including two doubles and two homers.

676475.author: Chase Davis
676475.title: Alec Burleson keeps raking with three-hit day vs. Rockies
676475.desc: Alec Burleson went 3-for-5 in Sunday's 10-8 win over the Rockies with a double, a run scored and an RBI.
676475.impact: After the win, he's batting .283 across 143 games with 21 home runs, 103 RBI, 79 runs, four stolen bases and a .351 wOBA. He's just four RBI behind league leader Sal Stewart.

669357.author: Chase Davis
669357.title: Nolan Gorman goes deep in win over Rockies
669357.desc: Nolan Gorman went 1-for-5 in a win over the Rockies with a home run, one run scored and two RBI.
669357.impact: After Sunday's win over Colorado, Gorman is batting .186 with nine home runs, 31 RBI, 22 runs scored and a .261 wOBA across 73 games. He hasn't faced a lefty since being recalled from Triple-A, and he has a 33.3% strikeout rate in those 11 games.

680977.author: Ari Koslow
680977.title: Brendan Donovan (concussion) not making progress
680977.desc: Brendan Donovan said he's still dealing with nausea while doing drills.
680977.impact: Donovan suffered a concussion on August 22. It does not sound like he has a good chance to return this season.

660688.author: Ari Koslow
660688.title: Keibert Ruiz (head) in lineup Monday
660688.desc: Keibert Ruiz is in the lineup for Monday's game against the Padres.
660688.impact: Ruiz had been day-to-day after missing time for precautionary reasons with a possible head injury last week.

669684.author: Ari Koslow
669684.title: Chris Murphy activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
669684.desc: The White Sox activated LHP Chris Murphy from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Charlotte.
669684.impact: Murphy will remain in Triple-A after concluding his rehab assignment.

575929.author: Ari Koslow
575929.title: Willson Contreras (hamstring) could be activated Friday
575929.desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Willson Contreras could be activated as early as Friday.
575929.impact: Contreras could go out on a short rehab assignment before returning. He landed on the injured list a week ago.

592450.author: Ari Koslow
592450.title: Aaron Judge (rib) takes BP
592450.desc: Aaron Judge took batting practice on Monday.
592450.impact: Judge continues to make progress on his way back from a rib injury. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

592094.author: Ari Koslow
592094.title: Jason Adam (shoulder) throws bullpen Monday
592094.desc: Jason Adam threw a bullpen session on Monday.
592094.impact: Adam threw around 28 pitches. If he is feeling good, he could soon be cleared to face live hitters.

813349.author: Ari Koslow
813349.title: Connelly Early (elbow) to pitch in bridge league game Tuesday
813349.desc: Connelly Early will pitch in a bridge league game on Tuesday.
813349.impact: Early will see his first rehab game action since joining the Nationals in July.

675448.author: Ari Koslow
675448.title: Blake Hunt designated for assignment
675448.desc: The Padres designated Blake Hunt for assignment.
675448.impact: Hunt loses his spot on the 40-man roster. He will head to waivers.

666745.author: Ari Koslow
666745.title: Jhony Brito optioned to Triple-A
666745.desc: The Padres optioned Jhony Brito to Triple-A El Paso.
666745.impact: Brito will return to Triple-A to make room for the return of Nick Pivetta.

601713.author: Ari Koslow
601713.title: Nick Pivetta (elbow) activated from IL
601713.desc: The Padres activated Nick Pivetta from the injured list.
601713.impact: Pivetta makes his return for Monday's series opener as had been reported. Jhony Brito was optioned as the corresponding move.

656811.author: Ari Koslow
656811.title: Ryan O'Hearn (quad) cleared for rehab assignment
656811.desc: Ryan O'Hearn will begin a rehab assignment on Tuesday with Triple-A Indianapolis.
656811.impact: O'Hearn is on track to be activated later this week or early next week.

702056.author: Ari Koslow
702056.title: Trey Yesavage (knee) to throw live BP Thursday
702056.desc: Trey Yesavage is expected to face hitters in live batting practice Thursday.
702056.impact: Yesavage a 23-pitch bullpen session on Friday. He is expected to throw off the mound again on Monday. If all goes well, he'll advance to facing live hitters on Thursday.

672442.author: Ari Koslow
672442.title: Yovanny Cruz recalled from Triple-A
672442.desc: The Nationals recalled Yovanny Cruz from Triple-A Rochester.
672442.impact: Orlando Ribalta was placed on the injured list as the corresponding move. Cruz will return to a middle-relief role.

687377.author: Ari Koslow
687377.title: Orlando Ribalta (forearm) placed on IL
687377.desc: The Nationals placed Orlando Ribalta on the 15-day IL with right forearm inflammation.
687377.impact: Ribalta underwent an MRI with the results still pending. Yovanny Cruz was recalled as the corresponding move.

690986.author: Chris Schommer
690986.title: Kyle Harrison scheduled to start on mound Saturday
690986.desc: Kyle Harrison is scheduled to start on the mound for the Milwaukee Brewers against the Cincinnati Reds Saturday according to Adam McCalvy.
690986.impact: Harrison could be followed by bulk or long reliever according to manager Pat Murphy, as the left-hander has struggled to miss opposing bats after tantalizing fantasy managers early in the season with dynamic swing-and-miss stuff.

670183.author: Ari Koslow
670183.title: Garrett Acton optioned to Triple-A
670183.desc: The Twins optioned RHP Garrett Acton to Triple-A St. Paul.
670183.impact: Acton returns to Triple-A to make room for the return of Joe Ryan.

691720.author: Ari Koslow
691720.title: Kyle Karros activated from concussion IL
691720.desc: The Rockies activated 3B Kyle Karros from the 7-day concussion injured list.
691720.impact: Karros returns after missing the past couple weeks of action. Ryan Ritter was optioned as the corresponding move.

690022.author: Ari Koslow
690022.title: Ryan Ritter optioned to Triple-A
690022.desc: The Rockies optioned SS Ryan Ritter to Triple-A Albuquerque.
690022.impact: Ritter returns to Triple-A with Kyle Karros activated from the 7-day concussion injured list.

663795.author: Ari Koslow
663795.title: Justin Hagenman optioned to Triple-A
663795.desc: The Mets optioned RHP Justin Hagenman to Triple-A Syracuse.
663795.impact: Hagenman returned to Triple-A to make room for Jonah Tong.

687075.author: Ari Koslow
687075.title: Brandon Sproat recalled from Triple-A
687075.desc: The Brewers recalled RHP Brandon Sproat from Triple-A Nashville
687075.impact: Sproat will return to a relief role. It is possible he and Kyle Harrison could also piggyback each other as Harrison could have his role reduced following his recent struggles.

657746.author: Chris Schommer
657746.title: Joe Ryan (glute) activated from injured list, starting Monday
657746.desc: Joe Ryan (glute) has been activated from the 15-day injured list by the Minnesota Twins Monday the club announced.
657746.impact: Ryan returns after being sidelined for the last month, taking the hill on the road for the series opener against the Detroit Tigers Monday.

681982.author: Ari Koslow
681982.title: Grant Anderson (biceps) placed on IL
681982.desc: The Brewers placed RHP Grant Anderson on the 15-day injured list with right biceps inflammation.
681982.impact: It is a tough loss for the Brewers bullpen. Anderson does not hold a clear timetable to return.

676974.author: Ari Koslow
676974.title: Max Meyer (neck) resumes throwing
676974.desc: Max Meyer has resumed his throwing program.
676974.impact: Meyer landed on the injured list with a neck strain before the All-Star break. It remains unclear if he has a chance to return this season.

656557.author: Ari Koslow
656557.title: Tanner Houck (elbow) could return after three more rehab appearances
656557.desc: Tanner Houck might need just three rehab appearances before rejoining the Red Sox.
656557.impact: Houck is scheduled to throw about 20 pitches with Double-A Portland on Tuesday, then 40-45 with Portland on Friday. If all goes well, he could be activated next week or the week after.

664023.author: Ari Koslow
664023.title: Ian Happ (knee) not in lineup Monday
664023.desc: Ian Happ is out of the lineup on Monday against the Brewers.
664023.impact: Happ was scratched from Sunday's lineup with left knee discomfort. He remains day-to-day.

803011.author: Chris Schommer
803011.title: Sam Antonacci fills box score in rout of Twins
803011.desc: Sam Antonacci went 3-for-4 in Sunday's 10-1 win over the Twins with three doubles, two runs scored, and two RBI.
803011.impact: Antonacci continues a torrid stretch of late, getting on base in each of his last 14 contests. The 23-year-old has provided manager Will Venable with another impactful option as part of a streaky White Sox lineup to this point, slashing .265 with eight home runs, 72 runs scored, 43 RBI, and 17 stolen bases across 123 games.

678246.author: Chris Schommer
678246.title: Miguel Vargas chips in two hits, steal in win over Twins
678246.desc: Miguel Vargas went 2-for-5 in a win over the Twins with one RBI, one walk, and one stolen base.
678246.impact: Vargas continues a scorching stretch of late, reaching base in 23 of his last 24 contests. The infielder has rewarded manager Will Venable as one of the more dynamic options in a streaky White Sox lineup, carrying an .849 OPS with 30 homers, 79 RBI, 95 runs scored, and 16 stolen bases across 141 games.

545341.author: Chris Schommer
545341.title: Randal Grichuk homers in win over Twins
545341.desc: Randal Grichuk went 2-for-2 in a win over the Twins with a home run, one walk, one run scored, and two RBI.
545341.impact: Grichuk has provided mixed results of late, collecting hits in three of his last six contests. The veteran remains a mostly steady bat primarily used against opposing left-handed pitching when in the White Sox lineup for manager Will Venable, slashing .276 with 12 home runs, 36 RBI, and 33 runs scored across 101 games.

671976.author: Chris Schommer
671976.title: Tristan Peters racks up three hits in win over Twins
671976.desc: Tristan Peters went 3-for-5 in win over the Twins with two doubles, three runs scored and one RBI.
671976.impact: Peters continues a dynamic stretch of late, getting on base in 13 of his last 15 contests. The outfielder has rewarded manager Will Venable with a surprising impactful option in a streaky White Sox lineup for much of the season, posting an .822 OPS with 12 home runs, 53 RBI, 58 runs scored, and eight stolen bases across 138 games.

691019.author: Chris Schommer
691019.title: Kyle Teel goes deep in rout of Twins
691019.desc: Kyle Teel went 1-for-5 in a win over the Twins with a three-run home run.
691019.impact: Teel has struggled at the plate since returning, recording a hit for the first time in his last three contests Sunday night. The catcher remains mired in a frustrating season heavily affected by multiple stints on the injured list for manager Will Venable, batting .181 with three homers, 17 RBI, and 10 runs scored through 22 games.

664983.author: Chris Schommer
664983.title: Jake McCarthy racks up three hits, three RBI in loss to Cardinals
664983.desc: Jake McCarthy went 3-for-5 in a loss to the Cardinals with a home run, two runs scored, and three RBI.
664983.impact: McCarthy continues a dynamic stretch of late, getting on base in 17 of his last 18 contests. The outfielder provides manager Warren Schaeffer with one of the more impactful options as part of an underperforming Rockies lineup, carrying an .821 OPS with 15 home runs, 75 RBI, 71 runs scored, and 29 stolen bases across 128 games.

666160.author: Chris Schommer
666160.title: Mickey Moniak drives in four in loss to Cardinals
666160.desc: Mickey Moniak went 2-for-4 in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals with a home run, one run scored, and four RBI.
666160.impact: Moniak has offered mixed results at the plate of late, registering hits in six of his last 12 contests. the 28-year-old has flashed his electric bat as another streaky option in the Rockies lineup to this point, slashing .251 with 22 homers, 64 RBI, 47 runs scored, and one stolen base through 103 games.

681198.author: Chris Schommer
681198.title: TJ Rumfield racks up three hits in loss to Cardinals
681198.desc: TJ Rumfield went 3-for-4 in a loss to the Cardinals with a double, two runs scored, and one RBI.
681198.impact: Rumfield has caught fire again at the plate, driving in runs in each of his last five contests. The 26-year-old offers manager Warren Schaeffer one of the more dynamic bats as part of an inconsistent Rockies lineup, posting an .849 OPS with 15 home runs, 67 RBI, and 61 runs scored across 139 games.

685299.author: Chris Schommer
685299.title: Tanner Gordon roughed up early in loss to Cardinals
685299.desc: Tanner Gordon allowed five earned runs on eight hits and one walk while striking out four over 4 2/3 innings in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals.
685299.impact: Gordon has provided mixed results of late, allowing more than four earned runs in two of his last four contests. The right-hander remains another inconsistent arm in an underperforming Rockies rotation, posting a 5.40 ERA and 1.43 WHIP with a 1-4 record, .863 OPS allowed, and 7.3 K/9 ratio through 21 appearances.

543037.author: Chris Schommer
543037.title: Gerrit Cole labors through seven in loss to Padres
543037.desc: Gerrit Cole allowed four earned runs on six hits while striking out three over seven innings in Sunday's loss to the Padres.
543037.impact: Cole has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last three trips to the mound. The right-hander remains another stable option as part of a deep Yankees rotation for manager Aaron Boone, carrying a 3.41 ERA and 1.09 WHIP with an 8-8 record and 9.2 K/9 ratio through 19 starts.

695611.author: Chris Schommer
695611.title: Gage Jump solid through four in loss to Mariners
695611.desc: Gage Jump allowed two earned runs on six hits while striking out seven over four innings in Sunday's 2-0 loss to the Mariners.
695611.impact: Jump has offered mixed results of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander remains another inconsistent arm in the Athletics rotation to this point for manager Mark Kotsay, posting a 5.12 ERA and 1.49 WHIP with a 6-10 record and 9.9 K/9 ratio across 19 starts.

703607.author: Chris Schommer
703607.title: Henry Bolte steals base in loss to Mariners
703607.desc: Henry Bolte went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Mariners with one stolen base.
703607.impact: Bolte has heated back up of late, reaching base in eight of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of the more reliable options as part of an injury-riddled Athletics lineup late in the season, batting .274 with eight home runs, 16 stolen bases, 31 RBI, and 43 runs scored across 101 games.

694671.author: Chris Schommer
694671.title: Wyatt Langford swipes base in win over Rays
694671.desc: Wyatt Langford went 0-for-2 in a win over the Rays with one run scored, three walks, and one stolen base.
694671.impact: Langford has heated back up of late, getting on base in 11 of his last 14 contests. The outfielder remains one of many streaky options in the Rangers lineup to this point, batting .245 with 15 home runs, 36 RBI, 55 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 92 games.

608369.author: Chris Schommer
608369.title: Corey Seager goes deep in win over Rays
608369.desc: Corey Seager went 1-for-5 in a win over the Rays with a solo home run.
608369.impact: Seager has heated up of late, reaching base in eight of his last nine contests. The shortstop has been mired in a frustrating season as part of an inconsistent Rangers lineup for manager Skip Schumaker, slashing .227 with 15 home runs, 38 RBI, 49 runs scored, and one stolen base across 84 games.

669394.author: Chris Schommer
669394.title: Jake Burger goes yard twice in win over Rays
669394.desc: Jake Burger went 2-for-4 in Sunday's 8-6 win over the Rays with two home runs, three runs scored, three RBI, and one walk.
669394.impact: Burger continues a strong stretch at the plate of late, picking up hits in 10 of his last 13 contests. The 30-year-old has flashed a dynamic power stroke as another streaky bat in the Rangers lineup to this point, slashing .239 with 25 home runs, 82 RBI, 60 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 137 games.

677649.author: Chris Schommer
677649.title: Ezequiel Duran racks up three hits as Rangers outslug Rays
677649.desc: Ezequiel Duran went 3-for-5 in a win over the Rays with one run scored and one RBI.
677649.impact: Duran continues a torrid stretch of late, driving in runs in 10 of his last 14 contests. The 27-year-old offers manager Skip Schumaker one of the more impactful options in an inconsistent Rangers lineup, slashing .277 with 17 home runs, 78 RBI, 65 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 135 games.

669022.author: Chris Schommer
669022.title: MacKenzie Gore torched early in no-decision against Rays
669022.desc: MacKenzie Gore allowed five earned runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out one over three innings in Sunday's 8-6 win over the Rays.
669022.impact: Gore has provided mixed results of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of many inconsistent options in the Rangers rotation to this point, posting a 4.51 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with an 8-10 record and 9.7 K/9 ratio through 30 starts.

670541.author: Chris Schommer
670541.title: Yordan Alvarez goes deep in loss to Diamondbacks
670541.desc: Yordan Alvarez went 1-for-5 in a loss to the Diamondbacks with a solo home run.
670541.impact: Alvarez continues an impactful stretch of late, getting on base in 16 of his last 18 contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the few explosive bats in a streaky Astros lineup for manager Joe Espada, slashing .314 with 38 home runs, 95 RBI, 94 runs scored, and one stolen base across 142 games.

514888.author: Chris Schommer
514888.title: Jose Altuve racks up three hits in loss to Diamondbacks
514888.desc: Jose Altuve went 3-for-4 in a loss to the Diamondbacks with one double and one run scored.
514888.impact: Altuve has heated back up at the plate of late, recording hits in nine of his last 13 contests. The veteran remains one of many streaky options in the Astros lineup to this point, slashing .247 with 15 home runs, 44 RBI, 64 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 117 games.

662139.author: Chris Schommer
662139.title: Daulton Varsho swipes base in loss to Diamondbacks
662139.desc: Daulton Varsho went 0-for-3 in a loss to the Diamondbacks with one walk and one stolen base.
662139.impact: Varsho has heated up of late, reaching base in four of his last five contests. The outfielder has battled consistency issues for much of the season between Toronto and Houston, batting .226 with 10 homers, 38 RBI, 47 runs scored, and 12 stolen bases through 129 games.

663567.author: Chris Schommer
663567.title: Peter Lambert grinds through seven in loss to Diamondbacks
663567.desc: Peter Lambert allowed three earned runs on seven hits while striking out six over seven innings in Sunday's loss to the Diamondbacks.
663567.impact: Lambert continues a solid stretch of late, allowing two runs or less in eight of his last 12 trips to the mound. The right-hander offers manager Joe Espada one of the more stable arms as part of an inconsistent Astros rotation, posting a 3.67 ERA and 1.23 WHIP with an 8-8 record and 8.8 K/9 ratio through 25 starts.

702885.author: Chris Schommer
702885.title: Cesar Perdomo coasts through six scoreless in no-decision against Mets
702885.desc: Cesar Perdomo allowed three hits and one walk while striking out four over six scoreless innings in Sunday's loss to the Mets.
702885.impact: Perdomo continues a steady stretch, allowing one earned run or less in each of his two contests. The left-hander has offered manager Tony Vitello a stable option since being called up, posting a 0.90 ERA and 0.80 WHIP with an 0-0 record and 7.2 K/9 ratio through two appearances.

700712.author: Chris Schommer
700712.title: Walbert Urena strong on mound in tough-luck loss to Pirates
700712.desc: Walbert Urena allowed one earned run on three hits and one walk while striking out four over eight innings in Sunday's loss to the Pirates.
700712.impact: Urena continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in eight of his last 11 contests. The right-hander has turned into one of the few reliable arms as part of a disappointing Angels rotation for manager Kurt Suzuki, carrying a 2.74 ERA and 1.21 WHIP with a 9-10 record and 8.5 K/9 ratio across 26 appearances.

547973.author: Chris Schommer
547973.title: Aroldis Chapman slams door for another save in win over Orioles
547973.desc: Aroldis Chapman struck out two batters while allowing one hit in a scoreless frame to earn the save in Sunday's 3-1 win over the Orioles.
547973.impact: Chapman continues an impactful stretch of late, holding opponents scoreless in eight of his last nine contests. The left-hander remains a dynamic option in the ninth inning for manager Chad Tracy, posting a 2.03 ERA and 1.13 WHIP with 33 saves and a 12.0 K/9 ratio across 50 appearances.

801139.author: Chris Schommer
801139.title: Payton Tolle whiffs 12 in win over Orioles
801139.desc: Payton Tolle allowed one earned run on four hits and no walks while striking out 12 over six innings in Sunday's 3-1 win over the Orioles.
801139.impact: Tolle continues a strong stretch of late, allowing two earned runs or less in six of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander offers manager Chad Tracy one of the more impactful arms as part of a steady Red Sox rotation, carrying a 3.15 ERA and 1.08 WHIP with a 9-6 record and 10.5 K/9 ratio across 24 starts.

642201.author: Chris Schommer
642201.title: Eli White homers in win over Orioles
642201.desc: Eli White went 2-for-4 in a 3-1 win over the Orioles with a three-run home run.
642201.impact: White has caught fire of late, recording hits in each of his last six contests. The outfielder remains another streaky option in the Red Sox lineup late in the season, slashing .246 with six homers, 28 RBI, 27 runs scored, and five steals across 94 games.

668930.author: Chris Schommer
668930.title: Brice Turang drives in three in loss to Reds
668930.desc: Brice Turang went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Reds with a double, one run scored, two walks, and three RBI.
668930.impact: Turang has provided mixed results at the plate of late, collecting hits in six of his last 12 contests. The infielder remains one of the more impactful options as part of a versatile Brewers lineup, slashing .256 with 17 home runs, 85 RBI, 86 runs scored, and 18 stolen bases across 133 games.

641343.author: Chris Schommer
641343.title: Jake Bauers goes deep in loss to Reds
641343.desc: Jake Bauers went 1-for-2 in a loss to the Reds with a home run, three runs scored, three walks, and two RBI.
641343.impact: Bauers has caught fire again of late, getting on base in each of his last 13 contests. The 30-year-old continues to reward manager Pat Murphy as one of the more explosive bats as part of a versatile Brewers lineup, posting an .889 OPS with 24 home runs, 78 RBI, 82 runs scored, and 10 stolen bases across 129 games.

802415.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
802415.title: Chandler Simpson swipes bag Sunday
802415.desc: Chandler Simpson went 2-for-5 with two runs scored and one stolen base in Sunday's 8-6 loss to the Texas Rangers.
802415.impact: Simpson swiped his 39th base of the season, which ranks third in MLB. He now owns a .308/.336/.360 slash line with 14 doubles and six triples across 135 games.

693855.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
693855.title: Ian Seymour shaky in three-inning start Sunday
693855.desc: Ian Seymour allowed four runs (three earned) on five hits and one walk while striking out two across three innings in Sunday's 8-6 loss to the Texas Rangers.
693855.impact: Seymour pitched a clean first inning before allowing one run in the second. He kept the Rangers off the scoreboard in the third but ran into trouble again in the fourth, giving up a two-run shot to Jake Burger before Steven Matz entered and allowed a two-run double. The southpaw owns a 4.33 ERA and 1.16 WHIP with 140 strikeouts across 116.1 innings this season. His next scheduled start is on Saturday against the Houston Astros.

666182.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
666182.title: Bo Bichette hits one over fence Sunday
666182.desc: Bo Bichette went 1-for-4 with a run scored and three RBI in Sunday's 4-2 win over the San Francisco Giants.
666182.impact: Bichette sent his 16th homer of the season 412 feet to left-center field off Carson Seymour in the eighth inning, giving the New York Mets the lead. After a rough start to his tenure with the Mets, he's picked things up, slashing .284/.339/.455 with six homers over his last 45 games.

681035.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
681035.title: Christian Scott K's seven Sunday
681035.desc: Christian Scott allowed two runs on four hits and no walks while striking out seven across 4.2 innings in Sunday's 4-2 win over the San Francisco Giants.
681035.impact: Scott was dominant in this one, allowing just four hits while striking out seven. He's recorded at least six strikeouts in five of his last six starts, showcasing his strikeout upside. He owns a 3.81 ERA and 1.28 WHIP with 120 strikeouts across 99.1 innings this season. His next scheduled start is on Sunday against the New York Yankees.

673540.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
673540.title: Kodai Senga notches save Sunday
673540.desc: Kodai Senga tossed a 1-2-3 inning in Sunday's 4-2 win over the San Francisco Giants to record his sixth save of the season.
673540.impact: Senga was extremely efficient in this one, needing just 14 pitches to retire the side. He got Jonah Cox to ground out, Jung Hoo Lee to line out and Osleivis Basabe to strike out. While he owns a 7.11 ERA and 1.60 WHIP on the season, he's been much more effective since transitioning to the bullpen and taking over as the closer, posting a 3.91 ERA and 1.34 WHIP.

663969.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
663969.title: Tyler Phillips picks up win Sunday
663969.desc: Tyler Phillips allowed three runs on five hits and one walk while striking out three across five innings in Sunday's 10-3 win over the Chicago Cubs.
663969.impact: Phillips opened the contest with two scoreless innings before allowing a run in each of the third, fourth and fifth innings. He still did enough to earn the win and now owns a 2.70 ERA and 0.90 WHIP across two starts in September. His next scheduled start is on Saturday against the Los Angeles Dodgers.

691594.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
691594.title: Javier Sanoja goes deep Sunday
691594.desc: Javier Sanoja went 2-for-4 with a home run, two runs scored and two RBI in Sunday's 10-3 win over the Chicago Cubs.
691594.impact: Sanoja hit his eighth homer of the year Sunday, sending a 388-foot shot to left field off Colin Rea. The 23-year-old has now recorded a hit in all six games he's played in September, posting a .417/.440/.707 slash line with two homers.

681715.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
681715.title: Heriberto Hernandez launches one over fence Sunday
681715.desc: Heriberto Hernandez went 2-for-4 with a home run, a walk, two runs scored, two RBI and a stolen base in Sunday's 10-3 win over the Chicago Cubs.
681715.impact: After going hitless in the first two games of the series with four strikeouts, Hernandez bounced back by reaching base three times, including a homer off Clay Holmes in the fourth inning and a stolen base. He's now hit two homers in September and owns a .217/.333/.565 slash line.

805300.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
805300.title: Jakob Marsee swipes bag Sunday
805300.desc: Jakob Marsee went 2-for-4 with a walk, one run scored and a stolen base in Sunday's 10-3 win over the Chicago Cubs.
805300.impact: Marsee reached base safely three times Sunday while drawing a walk in his third consecutive game. He's off to a strong start in September, posting a .391 OBP and .444 SLG with one homer and one stolen base.

672640.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
672640.title: Otto Lopez steals base Sunday
672640.desc: Otto Lopez went 2-for-4 with one run scored, one RBI and a stolen base in Sunday's 10-3 win over the Chicago Cubs.
672640.impact: Lopez stole his first base since August 26, when he swiped two bags in the same game, and has now recorded a hit in two straight contests. After an impressive start to the season, he's cooled off in the second half, batting .233/.278/.300 across 45 games.

605280.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
605280.title: Clay Holmes gets shelled for eight runs Sunday
605280.desc: Clay Holmes allowed eight earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out two across 4.1 innings in Sunday's 10-3 loss to the Miami Marlins.
605280.impact: Holmes struggled in this one, allowing a season-high eight runs. He gave up three runs through the first four innings before surrendering five more in the fifth. He now owns a 2.83 ERA and 1.12 WHIP with 65 strikeouts across 86 innings this season. His next scheduled start is on Saturday against the Pittsburgh Pirates.

691718.author: Nicholas Rodriguez
691718.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits 40th homer of season Sunday
691718.desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 1-for-3 with a home run, one run scored and two RBI in Sunday's 10-3 loss to the Miami Marlins.
691718.impact: Crow-Armstrong launched his 40th homer of the season off Tyler Phillips in the fifth inning, hitting a 403-foot shot to right field. He owns a .227/.333/.545 slash line with two homers and a stolen base over his last six games.

674841.author: Jesse Garcia
674841.title: Andrew Alvarez labors early as Nats fall short in LA
674841.desc: Andrew Alvarez allowed three earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out five over 4.1 innings in Sunday's loss to the Dodgers.
674841.impact: After the 7-5 defeat, he now holds a 3.60 ERA and 1.32 WHIP with a 2-6 record through 22 games. He is currently slated to take on the Angels at home in his next start.

682928.author: Jesse Garcia
682928.title: CJ Abrams goes deep but Nats come up short vs. Dodgers
682928.desc: CJ Abrams went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Dodgers with a home run, a walk, a run scored and one RBI while striking out twice.
682928.impact: After Sunday's loss, Abrams is slashing .265 with 30 home runs, 95 RBI, 84 runs scored and 27 stolen bases across 136 games. Abrams has really struggled at the plate as of late, hitting .183 over his last 30 games.

680694.author: Jesse Garcia
680694.title: Kyle Bradish battles wildness, takes tough loss
680694.desc: Kyle Bradish allowed zero earned runs on two hits and four walks while striking out three over four innings in Sunday's loss to the Red Sox.
680694.impact: After the defeat, he now owns a 3.91 ERA and 1.42 WHIP with an 8.3 K/9 and a 7-13 record across 28 starts. If the Orioles fall further out of contention during this losing streak, it will be worth monitoring if they shut Bradish down in his first season since returning from Tommy John surgery. He is currently slated to take on the Blue Jays on the road in his next outing.

666277.author: Chase Davis
666277.title: George Soriano closes the door for third save
666277.desc: George Soriano allowed one hit while picking up a strikeout in Sunday's win over the Rockies to earn his third save of the season.
666277.impact: After the win, Soriano now has a 4.26 ERA, 1.34 WHIP, a 9.1 K/9, three saves and 21 holds. Riley O'Brien was likely unavailable after pitching three of the previous four days, leaving the door open for Soriano.

681517.author: Chase Davis
681517.title: Kyle Leahy hit early and often in another short outing
681517.desc: Kyle Leahy allowed five earned runs on six hits and no walks while striking out six over 2.2 innings in Sunday's win over the Rockies.
681517.impact: Leahy allowed four hard hits and picked up five whiffs over his 55 pitches. It was his third start in a row failing to complete five innings or throw more than 65 pitches. After the win, he now has a 3.41 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 10-4 record through 27 starts. He'll face the White Sox next, but he's more of a glorified opener at this point than a traditional starter.

677587.author: Matthew Adam
677587.title: Brayan Rocchio pops a big fly in tight 3-2 win
677587.desc: Brayan Rocchio went 1-for-3 in a 3-2 win over the Tigers in 10 innings with a home run, a run scored, one RBI and a strikeout.
677587.impact: Rocchio's clutch solo homer tied the game at 2-2 in the fifth inning. Through 137 games, Rocchio is batting .246 with 13 home runs, 60 RBI, 55 runs scored and 18 stolen bases across 479 at-bats. He has three homers over his past four contests.

668909.author: Matthew Adam
668909.title: Gavin Williams racks up 11 Ks in six strong innings
668909.desc: Gavin Williams didn't have his sharpest command, but he still missed plenty of bats and kept Cleveland in position to win.
668909.impact: Williams allowed two earned runs on four hits and three walks while striking out 11 over six innings in Sunday's 3-2 win over the Tigers. After the victory, Williams now has a 3.78 ERA and 1.09 WHIP with a 13-7 record across 29 starts. He's notched double-digit strikeouts in three of his past four starts.

641927.author: Matthew Adam
641927.title: Bailey Ober fans six but exits early in lopsided loss
641927.desc: Bailey Ober allowed one earned run on four hits and three walks while striking out six over 4.1 innings in Sunday's 10-1 loss to the White Sox.
641927.impact: Ober turned in a solid effort but the bullpen was unable to keep it close after he departed. After the defeat, he now owns a 4.28 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with a 7-5 record across 22 starts.

686797.author: Matthew Adam
686797.title: Brooks Lee Pops Solo Shot in Lopsided Loss
686797.desc: Brooks Lee went 2-for-3 in a 10-1 loss to the White Sox on Sunday with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
686797.impact: Lee provided the only offense for the Twins in the lopsided loss. Lee is now batting .250 with 23 homers, 79 RBI, 63 runs scored and seven stolen bases across 137 games. He will look to continue to put the finishing touches on his breakout season over the final month.

605540.author: Ari Koslow
605540.title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) unlikely to return this season
605540.desc: Brandon Woodruff is not expected to return this season.
605540.impact: Brewers manager Pat Murphy said Woodruff has a "low possibility" of potentially returning in 2026.

691026.author: Ari Koslow
691026.title: Masyn Winn (thumb) takes BP
691026.desc: Masyn Winn took batting practice on Friday.
691026.impact: Winn was still dealing with pain tolerance and "directional issues." He took additional swings on Saturday and felt better.

677592.author: Ari Koslow
677592.title: Everson Pereira (hand) on IL
677592.desc: Everson Pereira is on the injured list with a left hand contusion.
677592.impact: Pereira does not hold a clear timetable to return.

657006.author: Ari Koslow
657006.title: Justin Steele (elbow) throws 27 pitches in rehab appearance Sunday
657006.desc: Justin Steele threw 27 pitches in two innings for Triple-A Iowa on Sunday.
657006.impact: Steele remains hopeful to return this season as a reliever.

571946.author: Ari Koslow
571946.title: Shelby Miller (elbow) makes rehab appearance Saturday
571946.desc: Shelby Miller threw two-thirds of an inning on Saturday.
571946.impact: Miller remains hopeful to be activated later in September.

668970.author: Ari Koslow
668970.title: Gavin Hollowell (shoulder) throws 22 pitches in rehab appearance
668970.desc: Gavin Hollowell threw 22 pitches over one inning for Triple-A Iowa on Saturday.
668970.impact: Hollowell is scheduled to make another rehab appearance on Tuesday.

665795.author: Ari Koslow
665795.title: Edward Cabrera (blister) throws 32 pitches in rehab appearance
665795.desc: Edward Cabrera threw 32 pitches in two-thirds of an inning on Friday in second rehab outing with Triple-A Iowa.
665795.impact: Cabrera remains hopeful to return as a reliever this season.

621020.author: Ari Koslow
621020.title: Dansby Swanson (oblique) swinging bat daily
621020.desc: Dansby Swanson has been swinging a bat daily.
621020.impact: Swanson has also been going through defensive work and agility/running drills. He remains hopeful to return later in September.

596133.author: Ari Koslow
596133.title: Luke Weaver dealing with poison ivy
596133.desc: Luke Weaver was attempting to pitch through poison ivy.
596133.impact: Weaver contracted it during the team's road trip to Miami on August 11 -13.

663647.author: Ari Koslow
663647.title: Ke'Bryan Hayes (groin) runs bases Sunday
663647.desc: Ke'Bryan Hayes ran the bases at Great American Ball Park on Sunday.
663647.impact: Hayes was placed on the injured list in late August.

668881.author: Ari Koslow
668881.title: Hunter Greene (elbow) to join Reds to do therapy Monday
668881.desc: Hunter Greene will join the Reds in Los Angeles on Monday and do therapy at Dodger Stadium.
668881.impact: Greene underwent a second Tommy John surgery.

669911.author: Ari Koslow
669911.title: Michael Toglia undergoes season-ending surgery
669911.desc: Michael Toglia underwent season-ending surgery to repair a torn labrum.
669911.impact: Toglia was transferred to the 60-day injured list.

668715.author: Ari Koslow
668715.title: Spencer Steer (wrist) to be re-evaluated September 11
668715.desc: Spencer Steer is being re-evaluated on September 11.
668715.impact: Steer will be re-evaluated to see if he can begin swinging a bat.

669194.author: Ari Koslow
669194.title: Ryne Nelson makes rehab appearance
669194.desc: Ryne Nelson made a rehab appearance on Saturday for Single-A Visalia.
669194.impact: Nelson threw one scoreless inning with two strikeouts. He could be activated this week as a reliever.

668678.author: Ari Koslow
668678.title: Zac Gallen (elbow) throws 60 pitches in sim game
668678.desc: Zac Gallen threw 60 pitches over four innings in a sim game on Friday.
668678.impact: Gallen is hopeful to be activated this week.

647336.author: Ari Koslow
647336.title: Michael Soroka (shoulder) throws 59 pitches in sim game
647336.desc: Michael Soroka threw 59 pitches over four innings in a simulated game on Friday.
647336.impact: Soroka is expected to be activated from the injured list this week.

657044.author: Ari Koslow
657044.title: Ryan Thompson not eligible to return in regular season
657044.desc: Ryan Thompson is ineligible to pitch again in the regular season.
657044.impact: Thompson is on the 60-day injured list.

621242.author: Ari Koslow
621242.title: Edwin Diaz (neck) makes rehab appearance
621242.desc: Edwin Diaz made a rehab appearance for Triple-A Oklahoma City on Sunday.
621242.impact: Diaz threw 16 pitches over one scoreless inning.

808963.author: Ari Koslow
808963.title: Roki Sasaki (blister) throws bullpen
808963.desc: Roki Sasaki threw a bullpen session on Friday.
808963.impact: Sasaki is hopeful to return by mid-September.

694813.author: Ari Koslow
694813.title: Gavin Stone (shoulder) has rehab assignment extended
694813.desc: Gavin Stone had his rehab assignment extended due to a minor biceps issue.
694813.impact: Stone remains hopeful to return in September.
